reviewed_by: Codex source review; independent /root/review_divergence_patch source and harness review, 2026-10-21

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: BN and explicitly seeded Radare2 recover 0x004F82B0..0x004F831C, six blocks/six edges. All 108 bytes match the retail listing; preceding RET/NOP establishes the boundary. Live angr still required by the gate.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: One x86 cdecl context pointer. DWORD fields +0x108 (enabled), +0xD8 (stack value), +0xE0 (written flag); pointer return is self on disabled path and incremented scalar encoded in EAX otherwise.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: DWORD flag 0/1; stack address 0x00B97B20 indexed by count*4; counter 0x00B97D24 incremented by one. No synthetic distance or scale.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: Reads D8 before writing E0 in each enabled branch. Compares full 384-byte test contexts and all 20 captured stack DWORDs; excludes aliases and counters outside 0/19.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: Calls Script_ParseEnumReal32_5 (0x004F1160) before loading enabled. Callee returns false only when BE==0 and BD!=0. Both mode branches retained. Frida compares counter, stack bytes, both mode bytes and complete context after each call.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Disabled returns self with full DWORD E0 cleared. Enabled stores original D8, increments count and returns incremented count. No overflow branch exists; overflow excluded from declared fixture scope.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: No floating-point instructions or arithmetic in this native or the mode-byte predicate.

limitations: Nonaliasing valid contexts; mode bytes 0/1; enabled 0/1/-1; counts 0/19 only.
Invalid pointers, negative/overflow counters, broader storage, aliases, concurrency and natural game-loop integration remain unverified.
